top_story.headline: No new FEC compliance filings surfaced since the last edition
top_story.dek: All 74 RFAI and Form 99 filings in the window were already reported in earlier editions.
paragraphs: The scripts found 74 RFAI (FRQ) and Form 99 filings received since November 1, 2026, and every one was covered in a prior edition. No new RFAIs, Form 99 letters, voided or negative transactions of $10,000 or more, or red-flag keyword hits turned up.

The FEC's API (api.open.fec.gov) was unreachable during this run, so this edition may be missing filings or transactions that would otherwise have appeared. Deadline Watch found nothing, and the money-out and megadonor extras follow below.

blocks.text: Itemized receipts of $1,000,000 or more that FEC processed since 10/28/2026 and DC Record hasn't reported before, from FEC Schedule A (2025-26 cycle). Super PACs file monthly or quarterly, so a gift can surface weeks after it was made. Gifts from other committees and organizations are included and labeled.
